Score 3, confirmation_state CONFIRMED, resting only on the /sut/ui/* pages and the Network-Information-API branch, which are genuinely reachable via the app's own documented /sut/login client-side-cookie flow. The auditor correctly excluded the documented but structurally unreachable 'API Metric Control Endpoints' family (SUT03-EV-0016, SUT03-EV-0017, SUT03-EV-0018) from the score, per protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md ('the evaluated version must already expose it') -- source-verified (SUT03-EV-0018) that the client-side-only login handler can never write to the server-side sessions object any code path reads. This is a well-reasoned, correctly-excluded documentation-vs-implementation contradiction (audit.md section 5), not a scoring gap.
Score 2. Stable, reasonably semantic markup exercised from a reproducible starting point (step 2 yes); no documented/known accessibility violation with a pre-declared outcome found (step 3 no).

Score 3, confirmation_state CONFIRMED. isImageNotLoadingUser() forcing every product thumbnail to fail to render, gated on a fixed account, matches the rubric's 'controlled visual condition' example verbatim. Cited as sibling precedent in the SUT-01 Visual Testing DISPUTED finding (derived-data/adjudication/SUT-01/adjudication.json): this mechanism is structurally the same kind of account-gated, deterministic, forced-broken-image condition SUT-01 declined to credit at Score 3 for a comparable mechanism (SUT01-EV-0020).

Score 2. The auditor self-flagged this boundary (unresolved.md, SUT-03-U02: 'a different auditor could reasonably read the same evidence as Score 1'). This adjudicator's review finds the Score 2 determination (real, SUT-specific, stable authentication/authorization logic beyond generic reachability, step 2 yes; no documented intentional vulnerability, step 3 no, SUT03-EV-0025) consistent with SUT-02's identical treatment of a directly comparable fact pattern (SUT02-EV-0018/0019). No cross-SUT inconsistency found; the repository-CI Semgrep finding (SUT03-EV-0026) was correctly excluded as not an application-level capability (AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md rule 4).

Score 1. No non-USD currency or i18n mechanism exists (step 2 no for a locale-differentiated ground truth); /api/offers is geolocation-gated but returns identical content for every matched city (SUT03-EV-0029), so it provides no locale-differentiated ground truth and does not meet the 'explicit market/locale selection' example. Correctly capped at Score 1 (generic tool reachability via geolocation override), not Score 0, since the endpoint itself is a reasonable, reachable surface.
